intent: Decouple verified PDF source identity and claim-relevant readable content from optional raw-byte materialization so transport friction does not block historical research, while preserving claim-scoped Evidence integrity and one logical document identity.
rationale: The existing source/archive capability already owns logical source identity and later immutable raw versions, while Grounded Evidence already owns claim-level content verification. The observed failure was coupling these two stages through a downloader-specific prerequisite. Extend CAP-0001 with locator/content/materialized lifecycle state and preserve CAP-0002's rule that unread locators cannot prove claims; do not create another source or Evidence owner.
